Description.DefaultText: A spirit blessing. Blesses your garden plants and your crop fields when you inspect them, making them stronger against pests and more resilient in general.
Description.Text: 一个精魄赐福。当你检查你的菜园和农田作物时，祝福它们，使它们更强韧、更抗病虫害。
Description.zh: 一个精魄赐福。当你检查你的菜园和农田作物时，祝福它们，使它们更强韧、更抗病虫害。
Description.en: A spirit blessing. Blesses your garden plants and your crop fields when you inspect them, making them stronger against pests and more resilient in general.
Description.ja: 精霊の祝福。育てている作物に祝福を与える。害獣などに対する耐性ができる。
